prompt_en: Create a photorealistic science-feature photograph in a midnight orbital wet laboratory. An unmistakably adult biologist derived from the supplied portrait’s oval face, brown eyes, and long dark wavy hair leans toward a microscope, adjusting a fine-focus control. Use the attached portrait as facial-appearance inspiration for a fictional adult researcher. Her hand compresses the dial; a calibrated monitor fills half the frame. It shows Anthrobot living biobots as microscopic irregular multicellular spheroids: microscopic, irregular multicellular spheroids made of living human airway tissue, each fringed with fine motile cilia, traveling across a scratched neural-tissue culture inside a microfluidic chamber. Each organism has an asymmetric rounded cellular body whose only external structures are fine radial cilia. Show a credible microscopic scale bridge between the physical petri-scale chamber microscope optics and magnified monitor. A dotted flow trace and displaced culture debris make motility legible. Cool instrument light grazes her face, balanced by Earthlight through the orbital window. Use a 35 mm environmental portrait with researcher, physical culture vessel, and magnified live view readable in one depth-layered composition, with believable lab reflections.
